videos.description: In this month's "In The Know”, Cathie Wood breaks down Kevin Warsh’s five task forces to overhaul the Fed, from quieting the daily chatter of Fed governors to cross-checking distorted government statistics against private data. She explains why Trueflation’s real-time reading of 1.75% headline inflation, less than half the official 4.2% CPI, suggests the 10-year Treasury yield could break down, and why the yield curve is behaving the way it did during the Industrial Revolution: sniffing out deflation.
